-customrule.Name: -customrule
-customrule.description: Allows the printout of any authorizationDB rule as well as setting of that rule to any custom mechanism(s)

-debug.Name: -debug
-debug.description: Does a dry run of the changes and prints out what would have happened

-defaultjcright.Name: -defaultjcright
-defaultjcright.description: Adds the mechanism to be used with the sudosaml binary

-demobilize.Name: -demobilize
-demobilize.description: Sets up Jamf Connect Login to only demobilze accounts

-notify.Name: -notify
-notify.description: Adds the DEP Notify addition to the corresponding -AD, or -Setup argument

-postauth.Name: -postauth
-postauth.description: Mechs to be used after system authentication

-preauth.Name: -preauth
-preauth.description: Mechs to be used between the login UI and actual authentication

-prelogin.Name: -prelogin
-prelogin.description: Mechs to be used before the actual UI is shown

-print.Name: -print
-print.description: Prints the current list of authorization mechanisms

-reset.Name: -reset
-reset.description: Resets the login screen to the factory settings

-setup.Name: -setup
-setup.description: Adds the DEP Notify addition to the corresponding -AD, or -Setup argument

-sysprefs.Name: -sysprefs
-sysprefs.description: Enables Azure authentication for the Network Preference Pane

-sysprefsreset.Name: -sysprefsreset
-sysprefsreset.description: Removes Azure authentication for the Network Preference Pane
